title: Sharing
subtitle: Manage your campaign's members and invitations

members.caption: Members of the campaign
members.empty: No members yet. Invite your group.
members.roleHint: Co-authors work on the world and its content and also see drafts. Players see their character and whatever has been revealed to them.
members.removeText: {name} loses access to this campaign. Characters and content stay. You can invite them again later.
members.removeSelfText: You leave this campaign and lose access to it. The game master can invite you again.
members.ownerHint: The game master owns the campaign; their role can't be changed.
